texts: Every apprentice who completes many solo nights of tending is invested as a Keeper by the Council.
When an apprentice's lantern fails, that apprentice's solo count resets.
When an apprentice's lantern dims, that apprentice's solo count resets.

fields.sentence: Every apprentice who completes many solo nights of tending is invested as a Keeper by the Council.
parse: (: apprentice_invested (Implication (And (Member $x apprentice) (Member $e2 complete) (Agent $e2 $x) (Theme $e2 (sk_nights $x)) (GroupOf (sk_nights $x) solo_night) (CardinalityPhrase (sk_nights $x) "many") (Of (sk_nights $x) tend)) (And (Member (sk_invest $x) invest) (Agent (sk_invest $x) sk_council_1) (Patient (sk_invest $x) $x) (Member (sk_keeper_state $x) keeper) (Experiencer (sk_keeper_state $x) $x) (Member $x keeper) (Result (sk_invest $x) (sk_keeper_state $x)))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: The rule premise contains Skolem-function terms — (sk_nights $x) fills the Theme, GroupOf, CardinalityPhrase and Of conjuncts — which the instruction set forbids outright ("a premise never contains a Skolem term ... a rule whose premise names a Skolem event nothing asserts can never fire"), so the relative clause should have bound a plain variable and this rule as written can never match.

q2_gaps: a noun + of-gerund complement whose head noun is not a nominalization ("solo nights of tending") — the head noun's own verb does not take the of-argument as object, so the nominalization-object oblique does not apply, and it is neither a relational-noun genitive, a partitive, nor a possessive
review.notes: Capitalized "a Keeper" and "the Council" are correctly treated as common nouns with no Name atom, the by-phrase takes Agent, and only one QuantifierPhrase companion is emitted since "many" counts things rather than quantifying a rule range. The "as a Keeper" predicative is routed through the resultative State-result shape by analogy with the become/turn-into kind change, which composes from stated rules but is not named for a passive "V X as Y".

issues.reason: 'Rule premises bind through plain variables. A premise never contains a Skolem term' — (sk_nights $x) fills the Theme, GroupOf, CardinalityPhrase, and Of premise conjuncts, and per the instruction set's own words a premise naming a Skolem term nothing asserts can never fire.

gaps_confirmed: a noun + of-gerund complement on a non-nominalization head ('solo nights of tending'): the verb-paraphrase test fails for 'night', and the phrase is neither a relational-noun genitive, a partitive, nor a possessive, so no of-phrase mapping covers it
adjudication.defect_summary: The compliant form binds the counted group through a plain premise variable — (Theme $e2 $g) (GroupOf $g solo_night) (CardinalityPhrase $g "many") (Of $g tend) — reserving Skolem-function terms for the conclusion.
adjudication.notes: The as-a-Keeper predicative routed through the State-result shape, the by-phrase Agent, the single 'every' QuantifierPhrase companion, and the capitalized-common-noun default for 'Keeper' and 'the Council' are all licensed; the Of-oblique on the group is acceptable improvisation within the confirmed gap.

fields.sentence: When an apprentice's lantern fails, that apprentice's solo count resets.
parse: (: apprentice_lantern_fails_resets_count (Implication (And (Member $a apprentice) (Member (sk_lantern $a) lantern) (Possession (sk_lantern $a) $a) (Member $e fail) (Patient $e (sk_lantern $a))) (And (Member (sk_solo_count $a) solo_count) (Possession (sk_solo_count $a) $a) (Member (sk_reset $e) reset) (Patient (sk_reset $e) (sk_solo_count $a)) (During (sk_reset $e) $e))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: The rule premise contains Skolem function terms - (Member (sk_lantern $a) lantern), (Possession (sk_lantern $a) $a) and (Patient $e (sk_lantern $a)) - which the instruction set forbids (a premise never contains a Skolem term; those belong to conclusions), so nothing can match the premise and the rule can never fire; the lantern should be a plain variable.

review.notes: Everything else is right: bare when-plus-indefinite routed to the rule form, Possession with possessed first, Patient on the intransitive fail and reset undergoers, the During tie, the solo_count genus with its non-predicable modifier suppressed, and that apprentice bound to the premise variable.

issues.reason: The premise embeds Skolem terms — (Member (sk_lantern $a) lantern), (Possession (sk_lantern $a) $a), (Patient $e (sk_lantern $a)) — violating 'Rule premises bind through plain variables. A premise never contains a Skolem term': function terms belong to conclusions, and since no top-level fact asserts these terms the rule can never fire.

adjudication.defect_summary: Compliant form: bind the lantern with a plain variable in the premise — (Implication (And (Member $a apprentice) (Member $l lantern) (Possession $l $a) (Member $e fail) (Patient $e $l)) ...) — keeping the conclusion's (sk_solo_count $a) / (sk_reset $e) Skolem terms, the During tie, and the solo_count genus as parsed.
adjudication.notes: Everything else follows the instruction set: whenever routing for the indefinite-participant regularity, Possession with possessed first, Patient on both change-of-state undergoers, and the per-apprentice dependent existential for the solo count.

fields.sentence: When an apprentice's lantern dims, that apprentice's solo count resets.
parse: (: when_dim_reset (Implication (And (Member $a apprentice) (Member $l lantern) (Possession $l $a) (Member $d dim) (Patient $d $l)) (And (Member (sk_count $a) solo_count) (Possession (sk_count $a) $a) (Member (sk_reset $d) reset) (Patient (sk_reset $d) (sk_count $a)) (During (sk_reset $d) $d))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q2_gaps: A presupposed POSSESSED definite referent introduced in a rule's consequent ('that apprentice's solo count'): the instruction set projects definites out of seals and denial bundles but has no equivalent rule for rule consequents, so the count's existence and its Possession link only come into being when the lantern dims.
review.notes: Possession (possessed first) for both genitives, Patient for both intransitive change-of-state subjects, the $a-indexed Skolem count (one per apprentice, not per occurrence) and the During link all match the instruction set. The Skolem stem sk_count does not match its class symbol solo_count (cosmetic).
